# World Bank greenhouse-gas indicator

Authoritative source record for the World Bank greenhouse-gas export used by the historical `Medium-Blog/clima_portugal` analysis.

## Source

- Indicator: `EN.ATM.GHGT.KT.CE`
- Publisher: World Bank
- Indicator page: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/EN.ATM.GHGT.KT.CE
- General World Bank open-data licence: CC BY 4.0, subject to dataset-specific metadata and additional World Bank terms.

The historical Medium file `API_EN.ATM.GHGT.KT.CE_DS2_en_csv_v2_5607282.csv` remains with the article. The notebook-derived `total-ghg-emissions.csv` also stays project-local.
